findings.location: ## Definition, clause (c) Outcome sets and exact values, final sentence
findings.evidence: The clause defines an exact value λ as the singleton {λ} with probability μ^A_ρ({λ}), but then says an exact value of an observable with no eigenvalues is outside the assignment. The assigned law is on Borel subsets of R; zero measure for every singleton means the law is atomless, not that real-valued outcomes are absent. This conflates no normalizable eigenvector or finite-resolution detector record with no value in the law's outcome space. I left the Definition unchanged because repairing its public interface requires downstream consumer review beyond batch 45.

findings.location: ## Postulate, clause (iv) Unsharp finite outcomes; Sources.references
findings.evidence: Clause (iv) adopts finite families of bounded positive effects F_a with Σ_a F_a=I and probabilities tr(ρF_a). The listed citations point to sharp/self-adjoint or ideal eigenbasis measurement and Born probabilities (Teschl §2.1, Tong §3.3, Binney and Skinner §1.4); the cited passages reviewed do not supply the bounded-effects extension or identify it as an independently sourced assumption. The assigned consumer reaches P2 and mentions clause (iv) only to defer its development. P2 is outside this batch's edit scope.
